ota_power_loss_recovery.requirement: Prove coherent old/new boot or automatic recovery after every persistent-operation interruption. Full staging alone is not rollback.

ota_first_boot_health.requirement: Confirm candidate health after reboot before retiring recovery state; bound failed boots without weakening antirollback.

customer_state_preservation.requirement: Pass populated-settings, identity and calibration comparisons after success/rejection/interruption AND physical reboot/reconnect tests.

production_signing.requirement: Reviewed private-key custody, provisioning/rotation, signing and exact-artifact verification; no public fixture trust in customer images.

runtime_security_profile.requirement: Reconcile the historical 10.2.1 lock with a security-reviewed target (10.3.2 removes compromised roots); pin exact UF2/compiler/CA evidence and qualify hardware.

flasher_profile_alignment.requirement: Prove the actual flasher runtime, source libraries and component override equal the signed bootstrap dependency identity. Catalog labels are not evidence.

real_upgrade_and_capacity.requirement: Test distinct supported installed A to shipped B, including libraries, entrypoint format, source/MPY aliases and peak FAT allocation with protected user data.

upstream_security_review.requirement: Resolve high/critical advisories against exact ESP-IDF, TLS, runtime and dependency commits/configuration. No blanket no-vulnerabilities claim.

hardware_regression.requirement: Qualify integrated SCD41/button/USB behavior and each advertised additional sensor (including both SCD43 units) on the exact image.

wifi_cloud_soak.requirement: Verify real Wi-Fi reconnect, same cloud identity, credential retention, TLS rejection matrix, sensor/UI behavior and defined-duration soak.

repository_release_controls.requirement: Review branch/tag protection, required checks/review, production signing approval and rollback procedures. main currently reports unprotected.
